Certainly! Here’s a draft of a concise professional follow-up email:

---

Subject: Request for Overdue Pricing Explanation

Dear [Vendor's Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to inquire about the overdue pricing explanation we received on [specific date]. It has been several days since your initial response, and I would greatly appreciate an update or further clarification regarding our inquiry. 

Could you please provide more details on why the explanation was not provided earlier? Additionally, if there are any specific documents or information that need to be reviewed, could you kindly share them with us?

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Company Name]  
[Contact Information]

---

Feel free to adjust the details as necessary.
